feat.notes: symmetric L2 logistic regression on side-feature differences, no intercept; 'coef' fit on decisive UFC fights 2010-2025, 'coef_valid' on 2010-2023 (produced the 2024-2025 numbers); priors = division rates from fights 2021-2025

meta.orientation: every probability is P(first-named fighter A wins); the model is exactly symmetric (swap A/B -> 1 - p)

experts.market: de-vigged closing moneyline (power method) P(A); optional
experts.ml: ML expert P(A) (tools/ml.py page model when present, else the feature LR in moe.json 'feat')
experts.feat_lr: feature logistic regression (moe.json 'feat'; computable from fighters.json profiles)

gate_inputs.layoffA/layoffB: days since the fighter's previous UFC fight (null = debut-like, 365)
gate_inputs.ageA/ageB: age in years at the fight date (null = 30)
gate_inputs.preufcA/preufcB: true when tools/preufc.py has the fighter's pre-UFC record

meta.notes: Production model refit on 2019-2025 with the hyper-parameters chosen by forward-chained CV inside 2019-2023; model_validated is the 2019-2023 fit that produced the 2024-2025 report.

chosen.rule: lowest forward-chained CV log loss (val years 2021-2023, mean over the four availability patterns); 2024-2025 not used for the choice
